metadata.description: OpenRemote's own plugins, each reviewed by moreweb before it is listed.

plugins.name: dictation
plugins.description: Speak into the composer: a microphone button that writes what you say at the cursor, through any OpenAI-compatible transcription service (OpenAI's own, another provider's, or a whisper server on your computer).

plugins.name: worktrunk
plugins.description: Git worktrees for your agents, through Worktrunk (wt): agents list, create, switch, merge and remove worktrees and hand work to a new chat in its own worktree; a Worktrees view and composer button; each chat shows its branch; Worktrunk installed and kept up to date from the view.
